Interfaces
Interface AntwortEmpfaenger

All Known Implementing Classes:
Steuerung
public interface AntwortEmpfaenger

Specifies interface for callback functions used by the NetworkInterface class. Must be implemented by instances using the NetworkInterface to communicate with GameServer.

Author:
H.-H. Paul

nachrichtEmpangen

public void nachrichtEmpangen(java.lang.String message)

verbindungVerloren

public void verbindungVerloren(java.lang.String message)
Method called by instance of NetworkInterface to signal nonexistence of connection to GameServer. This may be either when trying to establish connection or after explicite during connection shutdown.

Parameters:
message - Errormessage identifying cause of loss of connection.
